guard_rules.name: Single Window Principle
guard_rules.rule: Maximum 1 Excel COM instance per script execution. If orphaned EXCEL processes (≠14644) exist at startup, kill them and exit 20. If $xl is null after New-Object -ComObject, exit 30 immediately. Do NOT retry or create a new instance.
guard_rules.check_code: IF (Get-Process -Name EXCEL | Where-Object {$_.Id -ne 14644}).Count -gt 0 { KILL; EXIT 20 }; IF ($null -eq $xl) { EXIT 30 }
guard_rules.applies_to: All GUI-HUMAN-LIKE workorders that create Excel COM objects

guard_rules.name: Spawn Cap Counter
guard_rules.rule: Hard limit of 1 Excel process creation per script execution. Track $spawnCounter. If $spawnCounter > 1, exit 30. Retries must be new script invocations, not internal loops.
guard_rules.applies_to: All scripts that call New-Object -ComObject Excel.Application

guard_rules.name: Try/Finally Excel Lifecycle
guard_rules.rule: Excel COM object must be created inside a try block with a finally block that calls $xl.Quit() + ReleaseComObject + GC.Collect on every exit path. Linear cleanup is prohibited.
guard_rules.applies_to: All scripts that create Excel COM objects

guard_rules.name: Null Guard After COM Access
guard_rules.rule: After every New-Object -ComObject and every COM property/method access that returns an object, check for null before proceeding. If null, exit 30. Do not call methods on potentially null objects.
guard_rules.check_code: IF ($null -eq $xl) { EXIT 30 }; IF ($null -eq $wb) { EXIT 30 }; IF ($null -eq $ws) { EXIT 30 }
guard_rules.applies_to: All scripts that use COM automation

guard_rules.name: Hard Wall-Clock Timeout
guard_rules.rule: Hard 5-minute (300 second) timeout for the entire script execution. Check elapsed time at each loop iteration. If exceeded, kill all EXCEL processes (≠14644) and exit 30.
guard_rules.applies_to: All GUI-HUMAN-LIKE workorders with a stated time budget
